    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Attackable
    Defines attack behavior.
    Card
    Represents a base card with strength and defence values.
    CardAtk
    Represents an attack card.
    CardDf
    Represents a guard card.
    CardUI
    Displays a card in the user interface.
    CardUlt
    Represents an ultimate card.
    Character
    Represents a base character with battle stats.
    CharacterHpBar
    Displays and updates a character health bar.
    CutsceneControls
    Provides helper methods for game cutscenes.
    DeployMenu
    Builds the team deploy menu.
    Enemy
    Represents an enemy character.
    EnemyAI
    Handles enemy turn actions.
    EnemyModel
    Displays the enemy model in the user interface.
    GameLogic
    Controls the main game flow.
    GameLogic.ActionState
    Lists the action states used in the game flow.
    GameOver
    Builds the game over screen.
    Gameplay
    Builds the main gameplay screen.
    Guardable
    Defines guard behavior.
    JotaroAnimate
    Displays animation for Jotaro.
    MageAnimate
    Displays animation for the mage.
    Main
    Starts the application.
    MainMenu
    Builds the main menu screen.
    Operator
    Represents a playable operator.
    SceneAndSoundManager
    Controls scene changes and sound playback.
    SettingsMenu
    Builds the settings screen.
    SkillManager
    Manages skill effects used in battle.
    StandAnimate
    Displays animation for the stand companion.
    TurnIndicator
    Displays the current turn in the user interface.
    Ultable
    Defines ultimate skill behavior.
    XAnimate
    Provides a base animation view for characters.
